description: Raw bid/ask quote exactly as observed, plus ingest metadata.

ask.x-gie-unit: quote currency per unit (USD per troy ounce for XAUUSD)

ask_volume.description: Size at the best ask; null when the feed does not provide it.

bid.x-gie-unit: quote currency per unit (USD per troy ounce for XAUUSD)

bid_volume.description: Size at the best bid; null when the feed does not provide it.

event_time_ns.description: Timestamp given by the source, converted to UTC.

flags.description: Data-quality flags (empty when nothing is wrong).

origin.description: Whether the quote is a live broker observation, imported history or a fixture.

receive_time_ns.description: Local clock reading when GIE received the quote.  For imported history without a recorded receive time it equals event_time_ns plus the modelled feed delay.

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the message was written with.

seq.description: Ingest sequence of the (source, symbol) stream: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1.

source.description: Identifier of the feed that delivered the quote.

symbol.description: Canonical GIE symbol (XAUUSD is the only tradable one).

title: Tick 1.0.0

x-gie-invariants.rule: the CROSSED flag is present if and only if ask < bid
the EVENT_AFTER_RECEIVE flag is present if and only if event_time_ns > receive_time_ns
